Set \(D=(0,0), A=(0,3), C=(c,0), B=(c,2)\). Let \(P=(t,0)\), where \(0\le t\le c\). Then

\[
\overrightarrow{PA}=(-t,3),\qquad \overrightarrow{PB}=(c-t,2).
\]

So

\[
\overrightarrow{PA}+3\overrightarrow{PB}
=(-t,3)+3(c-t,2)
=(3c-4t,9).
\]

Thus

\[
|\overrightarrow{PA}+3\overrightarrow{PB}|
=\sqrt{(3c-4t)^2+81}.
\]

Choose \(t=\frac{3c}{4}\in[0,c]\), making \((3c-4t)^2=0\). Therefore the minimum value is

\[
\sqrt{0+81}=9.
\]

\[
\boxed{9}
\]
